page.overview:
Who is Rabayn Marushta?

Rabayn held the position for thirty-one years until her death in . She was Selame Necoine's successor and Dalaine Ndaye's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

She was a quite weak Amyrlin, not a puppet of the Hall but definitely not in true control of the situation.
